source: Walk-forward OOS 2021-01 to 2026-07, 8 crypto coins, hybrid lattice (re-anchor slack 4), ATR24, pessimistic fills (price must trade 3bp through a rung), maker 2bp / taker 5bp, stop slip modeled, 3x lever per level. Params chosen each year from prior years only (32-config grid).
caveats: Strategy design (gates, windows, spacing) was shaped on the same 2020-26 history; walk-forward only selects the 32-config parameter grid.
Survivor coins; no queue-position or adverse-selection model; 3bp penetration haircut is arbitrary.
5m-native test with the same fill haircut cut EV to ~+0.08R: edge is sensitive to fill quality.
Daniel's 0.5R EV bar is not met (EV +0.265R); this grid is judged on ret/DD and positive EV through pessimistic fills.
